lines.title: Core product lines
lines.subtitle: Automotive, industrial and specialty lubricants — grades and packaging can be matched to your duty cycle.

item1.name: Automotive engine oils
item1.desc: Premium base oils and advanced additive packages in full synthetic, semi-synthetic and mineral grades, with strong shear stability and low-temperature fluidity.

item2.name: Heavy-duty diesel engine oils
item2.desc: Built for severe duty and extended drain intervals, with strong detergency, oxidation stability, anti-wear protection and soot control.

item3.name: Heavy-duty gear oils
item3.desc: Synthetic base oils with advanced EP/anti-wear additives for high load-carrying capacity and pitting resistance.

item4.name: Anti-wear hydraulic oils
item4.desc: High VI refined base oils with efficient additive systems for stable performance under high pressure, speed and temperature.

item5.name: Antifreeze / coolant
item5.desc: High-purity ethylene glycol with advanced corrosion inhibitors for freeze, boil, corrosion and scale protection.

item6.name: Greases
item6.desc: Premium base oils and advanced thickeners with high-temperature stability, load capacity, water resistance and lasting lubrication.

item7.name: Industrial oils
item7.desc: Anti-wear/EP protection, rust prevention, demulsibility and foam control for a wide range of industrial machinery.

intro.title: An integrated lubricant manufacturer
intro.p1: Cerotd (Shandong) Lubrication Technology Co., Ltd. integrates R&D, production, sales, technical training and logistics. Based in the New Material Industrial Park, Rencheng District, Jining, Shandong, we serve automotive, industrial and construction-machinery customers with practical lubrication solutions.
intro.p2: With 20 years in the industry, we offer 100+ products and a distributor network across 20+ provinces, serving 1,000+ dealers. Our plant supports scaled manufacturing and reliable delivery, with annual production and sales up to 150,000 tons.
intro.p3: We stay focused on professionalism and partnership, aiming for more efficient, environmentally responsible and energy-saving lubrication solutions that help customers grow with us.
